criteria.description: CLI values take precedence over ENV values for the same field.
ENV values take precedence over config-file values for the same field.
Config-file values take precedence over defaults.
Only undefined means absent: a missing value falls through to the next source and finally to the documented default.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: **Only `undefined` means "not provided".** A value is taken from the highest-priority source in which it is not `undefined`.

criteria.description: retries: 0 (a falsy but legal value) survives merging.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: `0` is a legal value and must survive merging (e.g. `retries: 0` must stay `0`).

criteria.description: verbose: false (a falsy but legal value) survives merging.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: `false` is a legal value and must survive merging (e.g. `verbose: false` must stay `false`).

criteria.description: Public API unchanged: loadConfig is exported and takes one argument.
